prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Organize settings for a cross-device writing app. Read interface.md. Produce a concrete revised interaction specification. input_files.interface.md: Platforms: iOS/macOS. Everyday formatting actions and account deletion are mixed into one 80-row settings screen. Changing document font unexpectedly changes all other documents, and system permission states are shown as editable app switches.
